# Update customization data

This function supplies branding data for a specific application and theme.

Customization data includes brand logos and colors.

This function is used to save customization data for the Jupiter theme only.

Endpoint: POST /update_customizations
Version: 11.138.0.6
Security: BasicAuth

## Query parameters:

  - `application` (string, required)
    The application name for the customization.
    Enum: "cpanel", "webmail"

  - `data` (object, required)
    The theme data to save.
    Example: {"brand":{"colors":{"accent":"#00FF00","primary":"#961218"},"favicon":"","logo":{"description":"The orange logo for cPanel.","forDarkBackground":"","forLightBackground":""}},"documentation":{"url":"https://hosting.com/documentation"},"help":{"url":"https://hosting.com/get-help"}}

  - `theme` (string, required)
    The theme name for the customization.
    Enum: "jupiter"

## Response 200 fields (application/json):

  - `metadata` (object)

  - `metadata.command` (string)
    The method name called.
    Example: "update_customizations"

  - `metadata.reason` (string)
    The reason the API function failed when the metadata.result field is 0. This field may display a success message when a function succeeds.
    Example: "OK"

  - `metadata.result` (integer)
    * 1 — Success.
* 0 — Failed. Check the reason field for more details.
    Enum: 0, 1

  - `metadata.version` (integer)
    The version of the API function.
    Example: 1
